turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_dn_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`, `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `dn` (the birefringence at
    1064 nm, dimensionless).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict each candidate's birefringence at 1064 nm,
then select the 5 candidates whose birefringence is CLOSEST to 0.1.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The birefringence \(\mathrm{d}n\) vanishes by symmetry in cubic crystals and is otherwise controlled by the degree of optical anisotropy (cell shape + polarizable-atom packing). Direct comparison of lattice vectors and fractional coordinates in the given POSCARs therefore identifies a handful of pool entries that are isostructural (or belong to the same ordered-defect-chalcopyrite / wurtzite-related family) with training-set compounds whose measured \(\mathrm{d}n\) already lies near 0.1.

- c082 (Al\(_4\)Hg\(_2\)Se\(_8\)) is identical, after a trivial origin shift, to Ga\(_4\)Hg\(_2\)Se\(_8\) (\(\mathrm{d}n=0.105\)).
- c071 (Al\(_2\)Cu\(_2\)Ge\(_2\)Se\(_8\)) and c056 (In\(_2\)Ag\(_2\)Ge\(_2\)Se\(_8\)) are cation-ordered variants of the same I-III-IV-VI\(_2\) tetragonal family that contains In\(_2\)Cu\(_2\)Ge\(_2\)Se\(_8\) (0.094) and Ga\(_2\)Cu\(_2\)Ge\(_2\)Se\(_8\) (0.123).
- c066 (YCuTe\(_2\)) reproduces the hexagonal YAgTe\(_2\) structure (\(\mathrm{d}n=0.081\)) with only a group-11 substitution.
- c087 (Ca\(_8\)Cd\(_4\)As\(_8\)) is the exact As analogue of Ca\(_8\)Cd\(_4\)P\(_8\) (\(\mathrm{d}n=0.1285\)).

All other pool structures are either cubic (\(\mathrm{d}n=0\)), polytypic ZnS/SiC-like ( \(\mathrm{d}n\lesssim0.05\)), or isostructural with training compounds whose \(\mathrm{d}n\) is \(\ge0.19\) or \(\le0.04\). The five listed entries are therefore the closest to the target value 0.1 (ranked by increasing \(|\mathrm{d}n-0.1|\)).

Final: c082, c071, c056, c066, c087
